q: How many stories have 'rust' in the title?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'rust')

q: How many stories were posted from github.com?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'github.com'

q: How many stories mention postgres in the title?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'postgres')

q: How many stories did the user speckx post?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE author = 'speckx'

q: How many stories got at least 100 points?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE points >= 100

q: How many stories have no domain?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain IS NULL

q: How many stories with 'Show HN' in the title were posted?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, '"show hn"')

q: How many stories were posted on July 4, 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE created >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-04' AND created < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-05'

q: How many stories from arxiv.org got more than 10 points?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'arxiv.org' AND points > 10

q: How many stories mention both openai and microsoft in the title?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'openai microsoft')

q: What is the title of the story with the most points?
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which story had the most comments? Give its title.
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories ORDER BY comments DESC LIMIT 1

q: What are the titles of the 3 highest-scoring stories from github.com?
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'github.com' ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 3

q: What is the highest-scoring story by rbanffy? Give the title.
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories WHERE author = 'rbanffy' ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the most commented story with 'apple' in the title?
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'apple') ORDER BY comments DESC LIMIT 1

q: List the ids of the 5 highest-scoring stories posted after July 20, 2026.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories WHERE created >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-21' ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 5

q: What is the earliest story posted in the month? Give its id.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories ORDER BY created ASC LIMIT 1

q: What is the title of the top-scoring story from nytimes.com?
sql: SELECT title FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'nytimes.com' ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which 3 domains had the most stories?
sql: SELECT domain FROM hn_stories WHERE domain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY domain ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

q: Which author posted the most stories?
sql: SELECT author FROM hn_stories GROUP BY author ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average number of points of stories from github.com?
sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'github.com'

q: What is the total number of comments on stories with 'ai' in the title?
sql: SELECT SUM(comments) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'ai')

q: What is the maximum number of points any story from youtube.com received?
sql: SELECT MAX(points) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'youtube.com'

q: Which domain's stories about rust were posted most often?
sql: SELECT domain FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'rust') AND domain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY domain ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which author got the most total points?
sql: SELECT author FROM hn_stories GROUP BY author ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which day of July 2026 had the most stories posted?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created) AS d FROM hn_stories GROUP BY d ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many distinct authors posted stories from arxiv.org?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author) FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'arxiv.org'

q: What is the average number of comments on stories that mention 'linux'?
sql: SELECT AVG(comments) FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'linux')

q: Find the 5 stories most relevant to 'postgres performance'. Give their ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories WHERE MATCH(title, 'postgres OR performance') ORDER BY bm25(title, 'postgres performance') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Find the 5 stories most relevant to 'open weights models'. Give their ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories ORDER BY bm25(title, 'open weights models') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Search for stories about 'rust compiler' and give the top 5 ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories ORDER BY bm25(title, 'rust compiler') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Search for stories about 'sqlite' from github.com, top 5 ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories WHERE domain = 'github.com' ORDER BY bm25(title, 'sqlite') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Find the 5 best matches for 'electric cars battery'. Give their ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories ORDER BY bm25(title, 'electric cars battery') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Top 5 stories about 'nuclear energy' with at least 5 points, ids only.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories WHERE points >= 5 ORDER BY bm25(title, 'nuclear energy') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Find the 5 stories most relevant to 'gpu kernels' posted in the second half of July 2026. Give ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories WHERE created >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-16' ORDER BY bm25(title, 'gpu kernels') DESC LIMIT 5

q: Find the 5 best matches for 'privacy browser'. Give their ids.
sql: SELECT id FROM hn_stories ORDER BY bm25(title, 'privacy browser') DESC LIMIT 5
